learning_outcomes.text: Compute the sum of geometric and telescoping series, real or complex
Determine the nature of convergence of a series of real or complex numbers
Compute the Fourier series of a periodic function
Compute the Laurent series of an analytic function on an annulus
Classify the singularities of a quotient of analytic functions
Compute the residue of an analytic function on an annulus
Compute the line integral of a complex function using the residue theorem

syllabus_topics: Sequences and numerical series, real and complex - Convergence criteria
Complex functions; Limits e derivatives - Cauchy-Riemann equations; Analytic functions
